name: Sherman's Quest
description:
About This Game

Get ready for the new hit action-adventure-platformer game SHERMAN'S QUEST!

Play as the curious and friendly Sherman, running errands for your sister as you explore the quaint Veilwood Village and its vast forests. Fight, explore, and collect unique items as you discover ancient secrets, and thwart evil plans. As your friends in the village mysteriously start to transform into ghastly monsters wrecking havoc, what will you do?

Sherman's Quest is a collaborative effort created by a dedicated team of recent graduates. Aiming to provide a fun and inviting gameplay experience for any and everyone, it is being released as a completely free game! It is a linear narrative-driven open area game with a planned playtime of 2 hours.
short_desc: Welcome to SHERMAN'S QUEST! A cozy action-adventure game where you get to solve puzzles, run errands, and whack gnomes!
